property_summary: For any token id, C exposes metadata via uri(uint256), so its ERC165 introspection must advertise the IERC1155MetadataURI interface (bytes4(keccak256("uri(uint256)"))); the mutant removes that check, so supportsInterface on that selector returns false for every token id and violates the rule.
change_summary: Remove the IERC1155MetadataURI interfaceId check so supportsInterface no longer reports the metadata interface.
